name: St. Louis Post-Dispatch editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the St. Louis Post-Dispatch Center (staff review Sept. 2021; low or initial confidence as of Oct. 2026). No separate editorial-board rating was found.

name: League of Women Voters of Metro St. Louis (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters chapter that runs 'the nonpartisan election resource VOTE411' (https://www.lwvstl.org/about) and never endorses candidates. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: The Missouri Bar Judicial Performance Review Committee (YourMissouriJudges.org)
lean_basis: Run by The Missouri Bar, which calls itself 'a statewide organization that is dedicated to improving the legal profession, the law and the administration of justice for all Missourians' (https://yourmissourijudges.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: St. Louis Public Radio (voter guide, no endorsements)
lean_basis: Public radio newsroom (no endorsements) whose stated mission is 'To inform and provide a deeper understanding and appreciation of events, ideas and cultures for a more inspired and engaged public' (https://www.stlpr.org/about). No outside rating found, so it is shown as not rated.
